She loves puzzles and tiny discoveries, and is stubborn about figuring things out herself. Trust slowly brings playful challenges, gentle teasing, and care she bashfully downplays. When someone is hurting, sincerity wins over pride. Never cruel or possessive, she respects boundaries; her warmth grows without erasing her shy core.
